008package paint.fiji.tracks;
009
010/**
011 * Immutable representation of a single track’s quantitative attributes.
012 * <p>
013 * Each instance encapsulates per-track motion descriptors such as total
014 * distance traveled, diffusion coefficients, confinement ratio, and
015 * net displacement. Primarily used for summarizing TrackMate analysis
016 * results in higher-level PAINT workflows.
017 * </p>
018 */
019public final class TrackAttributes {
020    public final int    numberOfSpotsInTracks; // Number of spots (detections) in the track.
021    public final double totalDistance;         // Total path length traveled by the track (in spatial units of the dataset).
022    public final double diffusionCoeff;        // Diffusion coefficient (based on mean squared displacement relative to first spot).
023    public final double diffusionCoeffExt;     // Extended diffusion coefficient (based on step-wise mean squared displacement).
024    public final double confinementRatio;      // Confinement ratio = net displacement / total distance traveled.
025
026    /**
027     * Constructs a {@code TrackAttributes} instance with all motion-related metrics.
028     *
029     * @param numberOfSpotsInTracks the number of spots (or detections) in the track
030     * @param totalDistance the total distance traveled by the track
031     * @param diffusionCoeff the diffusion coefficient calculated from the mean squared displacement relative to the first spot
032     * @param diffusionCoeffExt the extended diffusion coefficient based on step-wise mean squared displacement
033     * @param confinementRatio the ratio of net displacement to total distance traveled
034     */
035    public TrackAttributes(int numberOfSpotsInTracks,
036                           double totalDistance,
037                           double diffusionCoeff,
038                           double diffusionCoeffExt,
039                           double confinementRatio) {
040        this.numberOfSpotsInTracks = numberOfSpotsInTracks;
041        this.totalDistance         = totalDistance;
042        this.diffusionCoeff        = diffusionCoeff;
043        this.diffusionCoeffExt     = diffusionCoeffExt;
044        this.confinementRatio      = confinementRatio;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * Constructs a default {@code TrackAttributes} instance with:
049     * <ul>
050     *   <li>{@code numberOfSpotsInTracks = 0}</li>
051     *   <li>All numeric fields initialized to {@code Double.NaN}</li>
052     * </ul>
053     * <p>
054     * Useful for representing tracks with insufficient data points or
055     * failed computations.
056     * </p>
057     */
058    public TrackAttributes() {
059        this(0,
060             Double.NaN,
061             Double.NaN,
062             Double.NaN,
063             Double.NaN);
064    }
065}
